title: Really hot Spurs return to top spot
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 17

rankings.summaryHtml: They're just about the hottest team out West. They're pretty much the healthiest. So they're tops after completing their annual February trek at 6-1, bouncing back from that Cleveland loss to win the game (in Minny) that mattered most.

rankings.summaryHtml: Had they beaten the Spurs, the top spot was theirs. No. 2 ain't bad, though, for the West's first team to reach 40 wins.

rankings.summaryHtml: Said so when Spurs and Pistons went on their long streaks and have to say so again: 13 wins in a row is 13 wins in a row, no matter who the opposition is. Could Nets still be the East's beast?
